title: Risk Register Update — Post-S801 Governance Correction

R1_dl008_certified.detail: 67 Certified DL-008 items were DL-029 forward-scan false positives. All 2,500 items verified via Function constructor same-object parse: 0 Certified DL-008. All 67 individually inspected and confirmed CLEAN. Root cause: CorrectChoice appears before QuestionID in all 5 pack files; any scanner searching forward from QID captures the NEXT item's CC → ~75% FP rate.

R2_pack_e_thinness.detail: S801 Agent I confirmed: 500 Certified items with median ExplanationCorrect=67 chars, 92.4% zero ASC/COSO/GAAP citations, 83.6% definition-match pattern, 79.4% Understand cognitive level, 0% Analyze. Structurally pristine (0 defects) but educationally impoverished. Learners using Pack E exclusively would practice definition recall only — no accounting application. Pack B (500 items, extensive citations, 87/100 distractor quality) is the benchmark standard for enhancement.

R3_clone_waste.detail: S801 Agents J/K found clone density FAR WORSE than S800 estimated. Pack C: 347/500 items (78.6%) are rotation-group clones — only 107 unique concepts. Pack D: 437/500 items (90.6%) — only 47 unique items across all 6 sections. S800 estimated '140 template-rotation items'; actual scope is 784 items across both packs. Currently 128 are Archived (Sections E/F), leaving ~656 Certified clone items in Sections A-D that inflate session composition. Pack D Section FD is 100% clones (all 75 items from the same 5-item rotation group). Pack D is effectively a 47-item pool artificially inflated to 500.

R4_concurrency.detail: DL-019 concurrent-write data loss was predicated on S700-era DL-008 remediation sessions being overwritten by DL-013 certification waves. S801 demonstrated those DL-008 items were already clean (DL-029 false positives). The '432 overwritten items' in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md DL-019 were ghost defects — the remediation was on non-existent violations. Concurrency risk remains real (no file-lock protocol) but the specific DL-019 incident was a measurement artifact. File-lock protocol remains unimplemented.

R5_hash_drift.detail: S801 Agent A confirmed all 5 pack file SHA-256 hashes differ from CURRENT_BASELINES.md. Drift is authorized (S530-S536 authorized sessions). No unauthorized modification detected. CURRENT_BASELINES.md was never updated post-S536. Risk is now documentation staleness only — no integrity concern. Needs baseline recapture in next write-authorized session.

new_risks.mitigation: Publish corrected SESSION_STATUS in S802 as P0 priority. Cross-reference all counts against raw file evidence per AGENTS.md §5.

new_risks.description: DL-029 forward-scan methodology is the root cause of 3 false P0 alarms (67 DL-008, FD-045 missing, FD-075 missing) across S800 and SESSION_STATUS. CorrectChoice-before-QuestionID is universal across all 5 packs. Any tool that locates a QID then searches forward for CC systematically grabs the NEXT item's answer letter (~75% false positive rate). All prior sessions' DL-008 scans using forward-search produced systematically inflated counts. The S700 ~395 DL-008 count and prior Pack D ~342 count were both inflated. Actual pre-S700-remediation DL-008 was ~73 items, not ~395.
new_risks.mitigation: Mandate Function constructor same-object parse (extract CC and EW fields from the SAME JSON object) for all future defect scans. Update all scan scripts in scripts/ to be CC-position-aware. Publish corrected DL-008 history in REVISION_HISTORY.md.
new_risks.status: ACTIVE — methodology correction documented, scripts not yet updated
